items.condition: A result silently changes a molecule's connectivity, charge, multiplicity or identity.
items.expected_action: Fail the affected molecule and do not treat its properties as valid.

items.condition: Reported properties come from a structure with an imaginary mode or without a documented minimum test.
items.expected_action: Fail the affected result unless a bounded failure is explicitly reported.

items.condition: The conclusion claims crystal mobility, perovskite adsorption or device PCE from these isolated-molecule results.
items.expected_action: Reject the conclusion as scientifically out of scope.
